ftpgrab_hosts.description: List of FTP mirrors to maintain. Each entry defines a host to mirror from and to where locally. Required fields are host, remote_path, and local_path; username and password default to anonymous and empty respectively if omitted (per ftpgrab(1) manpage). Format: host:username:password:remote_path:local_path per line in config file. Order preserved in output (one per line). See examples/ftpgrabrc in documentation (Debian package ftpgrab).
